-------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m7p0t5 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Desks, MaxOverrides
ASSUME MaxOverrides \in Nat

VARIABLES reg, status, overrides
vars == <<reg, status, overrides>>

Free == "free"
States == {"idle", "pending", "editing"}

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in (Desks \cup {Free})
  /\ status \in [Desks -> States]
  /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
  /\ reg = Free
  /\ status = [d \in Desks |-> "idle"]
  /\ overrides = 0

\* Atomic compare-and-swap: only succeeds against an empty register.
CasClaim(d) ==
  /\ reg = Free
  /\ status[d] = "idle"
  /\ reg' = d
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![d] = "pending"]
  /\ UNCHANGED overrides

EnterBook(d) ==
  /\ status[d] = "pending"
  /\ reg = d
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![d] = "editing"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, overrides>>

Release(d) ==
  /\ status[d] = "editing"
  /\ reg = d
  /\ reg' = Free
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED overrides

AdminOverride ==
  /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
  /\ reg # Free
  /\ status' = [d \in Desks |-> IF status[d] \in {"pending", "editing"}
                                THEN "idle" ELSE status[d]]
  /\ reg' = Free
  /\ overrides' = overrides + 1

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Desks : CasClaim(d) \/ EnterBook(d) \/ Release(d)
  \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The order book admits at most one editor: any two desks found editing coincide.
BookMutualExclusion ==
  \A a, b \in Desks :
    (status[a] = "editing" /\ status[b] = "editing") => a = b
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Desks = {d1, d2, d3}
  MaxOverrides = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BookMutualExclusion
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction where several trading desks compete to edit the single shared order book during the pre-open window. The book is a critical resource: only one desk may hold write access at any instant. Access is granted through a compare-and-swap register that starts empty; a desk may claim it only when it reads the register as empty and swaps in its own identity in one atomic step. Winning the swap makes a desk the pending owner, after which it may actually enter the book and begin editing. When finished the desk releases, clearing the register back to empty. A privileged exchange administrator may at any time issue an override that forcibly clears the register and evicts whatever desk currently holds or is entering the book, for example to halt a runaway algorithm; the exchange bounds how many overrides may fire during one auction. The override never grants access to a second desk, it only revokes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct trading desks are ever editing the order book at the same time.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m8p2t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, Segments, TotalShares
ASSUME TotalShares \in Nat

VARIABLES pool, parked, coarse, fine
vars == <<pool, parked, coarse, fine>>

None == "none"

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN parked[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
  /\ pool \in 0..TotalShares
  /\ parked \in [Segments -> 0..TotalShares]
  /\ coarse \in (Instances \cup {None})
  /\ fine \in [Segments -> (Instances \cup {None})]

Init ==
  /\ pool = TotalShares
  /\ parked = [s \in Segments |-> 0]
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ fine = [s \in Segments |-> None]

AcquireCoarse(i) ==
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ coarse' = i
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, parked, fine>>

AcquireFine(i, s) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ fine[s] = None
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, parked, coarse>>

Deposit(i, s) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ fine[s] = i
  /\ pool > 0
  /\ pool' = pool - 1
  /\ parked' = [parked EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Withdraw(i, s) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ fine[s] = i
  /\ parked[s] > 0
  /\ parked' = [parked EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
  /\ pool' = pool + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(i, s) ==
  /\ fine[s] = i
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, parked, coarse>>

ReleaseCoarse(i) ==
  /\ coarse = i
  /\ \A s \in Segments : fine[s] # i
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, parked, fine>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i) \/ ReleaseCoarse(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Segments :
        AcquireFine(i, s) \/ Deposit(i, s) \/ Withdraw(i, s) \/ ReleaseFine(i, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Shares are neither created nor destroyed: pool + everything parked = the start total.
SharesConserved == pool + SumOver(Segments) = TotalShares
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Instances = {a1, a2}
  Segments = {s1, s2}
  TotalShares = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SharesConserved
nl:
A stock exchange runs two independent opening auctions in parallel, and both draw shares from a single shared inventory pool of a security. To move shares, an auction must acquire locks hierarchically: first the coarse market-wide lock, then the fine per-segment lock for the segment it wants to touch. Only after holding both may it deposit shares from the pool into a segment's parked holding, or withdraw parked shares back into the pool. An auction releases the fine lock for a segment when done with it, and may release the coarse lock only once it holds no fine locks. Shares are never minted or burned by any of these moves; every deposit removes exactly what it adds and every withdrawal is the mirror image. The two auctions coordinate purely through the lock hierarchy, so they can never both be manipulating the same segment at once. The total number of shares in the system, whether sitting in the pool or parked at segments, must stay fixed for the entire pre-open window.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shares in the pool plus all shares parked across segments always equal the fixed starting total.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p4t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Members, Copies, MaxVersion
ASSUME Copies \in Nat /\ MaxVersion \in Nat

VARIABLES version, reserved, pending, held
vars == <<version, reserved, pending, held>>

Requests == [member : Members, seen : 0..MaxVersion]

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0..MaxVersion
  /\ reserved \in Nat
  /\ pending \in SUBSET Requests
  /\ held \in SUBSET Members

\* One pending request per member at a time.
HasPending(m) == \E r \in pending : r.member = m

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ reserved = 0
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ held = {}

Submit(m) ==
  /\ ~HasPending(m)
  /\ m \notin held
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {[member |-> m, seen |-> version]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, reserved, held>>

\* Reordered processing: any pending request may be the next committed.
\* Version stamp advances until it saturates at MaxVersion (bounded model).
Bump(v) == IF v < MaxVersion THEN v + 1 ELSE v

CommitAccept(r) ==
  /\ r \in pending
  /\ r.seen = version
  /\ reserved < Copies
  /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ held' = held \cup {r.member}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {r}

CommitReject(r) ==
  /\ r \in pending
  /\ r.seen # version
  /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, reserved, held>>

Cancel(m) ==
  /\ m \in held
  /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
  /\ version' = Bump(version)
  /\ held' = held \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Members : Submit(m) \/ Cancel(m)
  \/ \E r \in pending : CommitAccept(r) \/ CommitReject(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The desk never overbooks: active reservations stay within the copy count.
CapacityRespected == reserved <= Copies
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Members = {m1, m2, m3}
  Copies = 2
  MaxVersion = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A library runs an online reservation desk for a popular title that has a fixed number of lendable copies. Members place reservations optimistically: a member first reads the desk's current version stamp, prepares a request carrying that snapshot, and only later tries to commit it. Because requests travel over the network they can arrive and be processed in any order, not first-come-first-served. When a commit is processed the desk accepts it only if the snapshot version still matches the live version and a copy is still free; on acceptance it books a copy and bumps the version stamp. If the snapshot is stale because some other commit moved the version first, the commit is rejected and the member must retry with a fresh snapshot. A member may also cancel a held reservation, which frees a copy and again bumps the version. Through all of this reordering and retrying, the desk must never book more reservations than it has copies.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of active reservations never exceeds the number of copies.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m8p6t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, fineHolder, scanner
vars == <<epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, fineHolder, scanner>>

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ coarseHolder \in (Drones \cup {None})
  /\ coarseEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ fineHolder \in [Sectors -> (Drones \cup {None})]
  /\ scanner \in (Drones \cup {None})

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ coarseHolder = None
  /\ coarseEpoch = 0
  /\ fineHolder = [s \in Sectors |-> None]
  /\ scanner = None

AcquireCoarse(d) ==
  /\ coarseHolder = None
  /\ coarseHolder' = d
  /\ coarseEpoch' = epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, fineHolder, scanner>>

AcquireFine(d, s) ==
  /\ coarseHolder = d
  /\ coarseEpoch = epoch
  /\ fineHolder[s] = None
  /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![s] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, scanner>>

BeginScan(d, s) ==
  /\ scanner = None
  /\ coarseHolder = d
  /\ coarseEpoch = epoch
  /\ fineHolder[s] = d
  /\ scanner' = d
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, fineHolder>>

EndScan(d) ==
  /\ scanner = d
  /\ scanner' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, fineHolder>>

ReleaseFine(d, s) ==
  /\ fineHolder[s] = d
  /\ scanner # d
  /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![s] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, scanner>>

ReleaseCoarse(d) ==
  /\ coarseHolder = d
  /\ scanner # d
  /\ \A s \in Sectors : fineHolder[s] # d
  /\ coarseHolder' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarseEpoch, fineHolder, scanner>>

RevokeEpoch ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ scanner = None
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, coarseEpoch, fineHolder, scanner>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : AcquireCoarse(d) \/ EndScan(d) \/ ReleaseCoarse(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors :
        AcquireFine(d, s) \/ BeginScan(d, s) \/ ReleaseFine(d, s)
  \/ RevokeEpoch

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A scanning drone is never stale or unauthorized: it holds a current-epoch
\* coarse grant and the fine lock on some sector it is imaging.
AuthorizedScanner ==
  (scanner # None) =>
    /\ coarseHolder = scanner
    /\ coarseEpoch = epoch
    /\ \E s \in Sectors : fineHolder[s] = scanner
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Drones = {a, b}
  Sectors = {x1, x2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedScanner
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm assigns drones to scan ground sectors under a mission coordinator. To scan, a drone must acquire authorization hierarchically: first the coarse region grant from the coordinator, then the fine lock on the specific sector it will image. The coarse grant is stamped with the coordinator's current authorization epoch. Drones may be slow to react but do not fail outright, so a drone can still be holding an old coarse grant when the coordinator revokes authorization by advancing the epoch, for instance after a wind-shift replan. A drone holding a stale grant, one whose stamped epoch no longer matches the coordinator's, must not begin scanning; it has to release and re-acquire a fresh grant first. Only one drone actively scans at a time, and it must genuinely hold a current-epoch coarse grant plus the fine lock for its sector. Releasing locks and ending scans return the swarm to a state where fresh authorization can be handed out. The coordinator only revokes while no scan is in progress.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a drone is actively scanning, it holds a coarse grant stamped with the current epoch and the fine lock for its sector.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m3p3t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots, Scripts, MaxTerm
ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat

VARIABLES term, leader, owner, requests, log
vars == <<term, leader, owner, requests, log>>

None == "none"
Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

Reqs == [script : Scripts, slot : Slots]
Entries == [slot : Slots, script : Scripts, term : 0..MaxTerm]

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ leader \in (Nodes \cup {None})
  /\ owner \in [Slots -> (Scripts \cup {None})]
  /\ requests \in SUBSET Reqs
  /\ log \in SUBSET Entries

Allocated(sc) == \E s \in Slots : owner[s] = sc

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ leader = None
  /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> None]
  /\ requests = {}
  /\ log = {}

ElectLeader(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = Bump(term)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, requests, log>>

FailLeader(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, owner, requests, log>>

SubmitRequest(sc, s) ==
  /\ ~Allocated(sc)
  /\ [script |-> sc, slot |-> s] \notin requests
  /\ requests' = requests \cup {[script |-> sc, slot |-> s]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, owner, log>>

\* Leader allocates a free slot; reordered requests handled in any order.
Allocate(r) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ r \in requests
  /\ owner[r.slot] = None
  /\ ~Allocated(r.script)
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r.slot] = r.script]
  /\ log' = log \cup {[slot |-> r.slot, script |-> r.script, term |-> term]}
  /\ requests' = requests \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

RejectRequest(r) ==
  /\ r \in requests
  /\ owner[r.slot] # None
  /\ requests' = requests \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, owner, log>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : ElectLeader(n) \/ FailLeader(n)
  \/ \E sc \in Scripts, s \in Slots : SubmitRequest(sc, s)
  \/ \E r \in requests : Allocate(r) \/ RejectRequest(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The allocation log is functional on slots: one slot never maps to two scripts.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A e1, e2 \in log : (e1.slot = e2.slot) => (e1.script = e2.script)
=============================================================================
nl:
A pharmacy runs a bank of dispenser nodes that fill prescriptions into numbered pickup slots. At any time one node is the elected leader and is the only node permitted to allocate a slot to a prescription. Fill requests arrive over an internal bus and may be reordered, so the leader can see them in any order rather than the order they were sent. When the leader allocates, it records the assignment in a durable allocation log tagged with its election term. If the requested slot is already taken the request is rejected instead. The system supports failover: the current leader can fail and step aside, leaving no leader until a new one is elected under a fresh (or saturated) term. Because a slot must map to exactly one prescription, the log must stay consistent: no slot may ever appear allocated to two different prescriptions, even across leader changes and reordered requests.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever recorded as allocated to two different prescriptions.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m7p5t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars

VARIABLES reg, runner, progress, doors
vars == <<reg, runner, progress, doors>>

Free == "free"
None == "none"
Phases == {"idle", "won", "ran"}

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in (Cars \cup {Free})
  /\ runner \in (Cars \cup {None})
  /\ progress \in [Cars -> Phases]
  /\ doors \in [Cars -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ reg = Free
  /\ runner = None
  /\ progress = [c \in Cars |-> "idle"]
  /\ doors = [c \in Cars |-> TRUE]   \* TRUE = open

\* Atomic compare-and-swap claim of the arming register.
Claim(c) ==
  /\ reg = Free
  /\ progress[c] = "idle"
  /\ reg' = c
  /\ progress' = [progress EXCEPT ![c] = "won"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<runner, doors>>

\* Slow winner declines and releases without running.
Abort(c) ==
  /\ progress[c] = "won"
  /\ reg = c
  /\ reg' = Free
  /\ progress' = [progress EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ doors' = [doors EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED runner

CloseDoors(c) ==
  /\ progress[c] = "won"
  /\ doors[c] = TRUE
  /\ doors' = [doors EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, runner, progress>>

\* Irreversible express run: only possible while no runner is latched yet.
ExpressRun(c) ==
  /\ progress[c] = "won"
  /\ reg = c
  /\ doors[c] = FALSE
  /\ runner = None
  /\ runner' = c
  /\ progress' = [progress EXCEPT ![c] = "ran"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, doors>>

ReleaseAfterRun(c) ==
  /\ progress[c] = "ran"
  /\ reg = c
  /\ reg' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<runner, progress, doors>>

Next ==
  \E c \in Cars :
    Claim(c) \/ Abort(c) \/ CloseDoors(c) \/ ExpressRun(c) \/ ReleaseAfterRun(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible run is single-shot: anything that ran is the latched runner.
SingleExpressRun ==
  \A c \in Cars : (progress[c] = "ran") => (c = runner)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cars = {c1, c2, c3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SingleExpressRun
nl:
A skyscraper elevator bank must, on a fire alarm, send exactly one car on an irreversible emergency express run straight to the lobby. Cars compete for the right to make this run through a single compare-and-swap arming register that starts free: a car may claim it only by reading it free and swapping in its own identity atomically. Winning the claim does not commit the car; a car can be slow but never fails, so a slow winner may decline and abort, releasing the register so another car can claim it. Before actually running, the winning car must close its doors. Only a car that both holds the register and has its doors closed may perform the express run, and the run is irreversible: once any car has made it, a latch records that car as the runner and no further express run may ever occur. After running, the car releases the register, but the runner latch stays set so the express run can never happen a second time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every car that has performed the emergency express run is the one latched runner, so the run occurs at most once.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m7p3t5 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Members, Slots, MaxOverrides
ASSUME MaxOverrides \in Nat

VARIABLES slotReg, holds, sealed, overrides
vars == <<slotReg, holds, sealed, overrides>>

Free == "free"

TypeOK ==
  /\ slotReg \in [Slots -> (Members \cup {Free})]
  /\ holds \in [Members -> SUBSET Slots]
  /\ sealed \in SUBSET Slots
  /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
  /\ slotReg = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
  /\ holds = [m \in Members |-> {}]
  /\ sealed = {}
  /\ overrides = 0

CasClaim(m, s) ==
  /\ slotReg[s] = Free
  /\ s \notin sealed
  /\ slotReg' = [slotReg EXCEPT ![s] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, sealed, overrides>>

Confirm(m, s) ==
  /\ slotReg[s] = m
  /\ s \notin holds[m]
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![m] = @ \cup {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotReg, sealed, overrides>>

Release(m, s) ==
  /\ s \in holds[m]
  /\ slotReg' = [slotReg EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![m] = @ \ {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, overrides>>

\* Privileged override: free the register AND erase every stale belief for slot s.
AdminOverride(s) ==
  /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
  /\ slotReg[s] # Free
  /\ slotReg' = [slotReg EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
  /\ holds' = [m \in Members |-> holds[m] \ {s}]
  /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {s}
  /\ overrides' = overrides + 1

AdminUnseal(s) ==
  /\ s \in sealed
  /\ sealed' = sealed \ {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slotReg, holds, overrides>>

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Members, s \in Slots : CasClaim(m, s) \/ Confirm(m, s) \/ Release(m, s)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : AdminOverride(s) \/ AdminUnseal(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every held slot is backed by the register naming that same member.
BeliefBackedByRegister ==
  \A m \in Members, s \in Slots : (s \in holds[m]) => (slotReg[s] = m)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Members = {m1, m2}
  Slots = {s1, s2}
  MaxOverrides = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BeliefBackedByRegister
nl:
A library reservation system lets members claim numbered hold slots for a book. Each slot has its own compare-and-swap ownership register that starts free; a member claims a slot by atomically swapping its identity in only when the register reads free. After winning the register a member confirms the reservation, recording in its own held-slots list that it believes it owns that slot. A member can release a slot it holds, dropping it from its list and freeing the register. A privileged librarian may issue an admin override on any slot: this forcibly frees the register and, crucially, also erases that slot from whatever member's held list still claims it, so no member is left believing it owns a slot the register has taken away. An overridden slot becomes sealed and cannot be claimed again until the librarian unseals it. The core guarantee is that a member's belief must always be backed by the register: a member holds a slot only when that slot's register names exactly that member, which prevents two members ever holding the same slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A member lists a slot as held only if that slot's ownership register currently names that same member.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m8p4t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Engines, Partitions, Capacity
ASSUME Capacity \in Nat

VARIABLES used, pend, coarse, fine
vars == <<used, pend, coarse, fine>>

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ used \in Nat
  /\ pend \in [Partitions -> Nat]
  /\ coarse \in (Engines \cup {None})
  /\ fine \in [Partitions -> (Engines \cup {None})]

Init ==
  /\ used = 0
  /\ pend = [p \in Partitions |-> 0]
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ fine = [p \in Partitions |-> None]

AcquireCoarse(e) ==
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ coarse' = e
  /\ UNCHANGED <<used, pend, fine>>

AcquireFine(e, p) ==
  /\ coarse = e
  /\ fine[p] = None
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = e]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<used, pend, coarse>>

Enqueue(e, p) ==
  /\ coarse = e
  /\ fine[p] = e
  /\ used < Capacity
  /\ used' = used + 1
  /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Settle(e, p) ==
  /\ coarse = e
  /\ fine[p] = e
  /\ pend[p] > 0
  /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
  /\ used' = used - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(e, p) ==
  /\ fine[p] = e
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<used, pend, coarse>>

ReleaseCoarse(e) ==
  /\ coarse = e
  /\ \A p \in Partitions : fine[p] # e
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<used, pend, fine>>

Next ==
  \/ \E e \in Engines : AcquireCoarse(e) \/ ReleaseCoarse(e)
  \/ \E e \in Engines, p \in Partitions :
        AcquireFine(e, p) \/ Enqueue(e, p) \/ Settle(e, p) \/ ReleaseFine(e, p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The shared buffer never overflows its fixed capacity.
BufferWithinCapacity == used <= Capacity
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Engines = {e1, e2}
  Partitions = {p1, p2}
  Capacity = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BufferWithinCapacity
nl:
A bank runs two independent interbank settlement engines that both feed a single shared settlement buffer of fixed capacity. The buffer holds transfers that have been posted but not yet cleared. To post a transfer an engine must take locks hierarchically: first the coarse batch-window lock, then the fine lock on the specific ledger partition it will write. Only while holding both may an engine enqueue a transfer into a partition, which consumes one shared buffer slot, or settle a queued transfer out of a partition, which frees one shared buffer slot. Because the two engines draw enqueue slots from the same shared buffer, the buffer's used-slot count is the contended resource. An engine releases the fine lock when done with a partition and may drop the coarse lock only once it holds no fine locks. No matter how the two engines interleave, the shared buffer must never hold more transfers than its capacity allows.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of used shared buffer slots never exceeds the buffer capacity.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m3p4t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Capacity, MaxTerm
ASSUME Capacity \in Nat /\ MaxTerm \in Nat

VARIABLES term, role, myTerm, queueLen
vars == <<term, role, myTerm, queueLen>>

Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ role \in [Nodes -> {"follower", "leader"}]
  /\ myTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]
  /\ queueLen \in Nat

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ role = [n \in Nodes |-> "follower"]
  /\ myTerm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
  /\ queueLen = 0

BecomeLeader(n) ==
  /\ role[n] = "follower"
  /\ term' = Bump(term)
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "leader"]
  /\ myTerm' = [myTerm EXCEPT ![n] = Bump(term)]
  /\ UNCHANGED queueLen

StepDown(n) ==
  /\ role[n] = "leader"
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, myTerm, queueLen>>

\* Only a current-term leader may admit; a stale leader (myTerm < term) is blocked.
Admit(n) ==
  /\ role[n] = "leader"
  /\ myTerm[n] = term
  /\ queueLen < Capacity
  /\ queueLen' = queueLen + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, myTerm>>

PrintHead ==
  /\ queueLen > 0
  /\ queueLen' = queueLen - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, myTerm>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : BecomeLeader(n) \/ StepDown(n) \/ Admit(n)
  \/ PrintHead

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The shared print queue never grows past its capacity.
QueueWithinCapacity == queueLen <= Capacity
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
  Capacity = 3
  MaxTerm = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QueueWithinCapacity
nl:
A print shop runs several spooler nodes that admit jobs into a single shared print queue of bounded capacity. A node may admit jobs only while it is acting as leader for the current term. Leadership uses failover: a follower can take over by adopting a new, higher term and declaring itself leader, and a leader can step down. Nodes can be slow but never crash, so an old leader that has been superseded may still carry its role marker while its remembered term has fallen behind the current term. Such a stale leader must not admit jobs; only a leader whose remembered term matches the current term is allowed to admit. Admitting a job consumes a queue slot, and any worker can print the head job to free a slot. The remembered term is what gates admission, so even when a slow node still thinks of itself as leader it cannot push the queue past its limit once its term is stale. Across all elections, stepdowns, and stale-node interleavings the shared queue must never exceed its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The print queue length never exceeds its fixed capacity.

  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, armed, seals>>

  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenAt, armed, seals>>

  /\ armed[b]

  /\ seals' = {b}

  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Arm(b) \/ Occupy(b) \/ Clear(b) \/ Seal(b)

  NB = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommissionAtMostOnce
nl:
A subway line is divided into signalling blocks arranged in a ring, and a single circulating token grants exclusive authority: only the block currently holding the token may act on the shared line. The token is passed hand to hand around the ring from each block to its successor. Trains occupy and later clear blocks, so a block can be occupied at times. The line has a one-time irreversible commissioning seal that must be placed exactly once for the whole line. A block prepares to seal by arming itself while it holds the token; it can be slow to do so but never fails, so it may hold the token and arm at its own pace. Placing the seal requires the block to hold the token, to be armed, to be currently unoccupied by a train, and for no seal to have been placed anywhere before. Once any block places the seal, the commissioning is permanently recorded and no block may ever place it again. The token keeps circulating regardless.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one block ever places the line commissioning seal.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p0t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Txns, Participants

VARIABLES phase, votes, stationFree, holder
vars == <<phase, votes, stationFree, holder>>

None == "none"
Phases == {"idle", "voting", "held"}
Ballots == {"none", "yes", "no"}

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Txns -> Phases]
  /\ votes \in [Txns -> [Participants -> Ballots]]
  /\ stationFree \in BOOLEAN
  /\ holder \in (Txns \cup {None})

Init ==
  /\ phase = [t \in Txns |-> "idle"]
  /\ votes = [t \in Txns |-> [p \in Participants |-> "none"]]
  /\ stationFree = TRUE
  /\ holder = None

OpenVote(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "voting"]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stationFree, holder>>

VoteYes(t, p) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "voting"
  /\ votes[t][p] = "none"
  /\ stationFree
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t][p] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, stationFree, holder>>

VoteNo(t, p) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "voting"
  /\ votes[t][p] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t][p] = "no"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, stationFree, holder>>

Commit(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "voting"
  /\ \A p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "yes"
  /\ stationFree
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "held"]
  /\ stationFree' = FALSE
  /\ holder' = t
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

Abort(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "voting"
  /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "no"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, stationFree, holder>>

Release(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "held"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
  /\ stationFree' = TRUE
  /\ holder' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Txns : OpenVote(t) \/ Commit(t) \/ Abort(t) \/ Release(t)
  \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Participants : VoteYes(t, p) \/ VoteNo(t, p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The single holder witness pins the critical section: any held transaction is
\* the recorded holder, so two transactions cannot hold the station together.
StationMutualExclusion ==
  /\ \A t \in Txns : (phase[t] = "held") => (holder = t)
  /\ (holder # None) => (~stationFree)
=============================================================================
nl:
A blood-bank network shares one critical cross-match station that only one allocation transaction may hold at a time. Acquiring the station runs a two-phase commit: a coordinator opens a vote for a transaction, each participant bank votes, and the transaction commits only if every participant voted yes and the station is still free. A participant votes yes only when it observes the station free; otherwise it may vote no to decline. Participants can be slow but never fail, so a vote may lag, leaving the coordinator waiting rather than crashing. When a transaction commits it takes the station and becomes its holder, marking the station busy. A committed transaction later releases, freeing the station and clearing the holder. If any participant votes no the vote is aborted and the transaction returns to idle to try again later. The station is the mutually exclusive resource: the recorded holder pins down whoever is in the critical section, so two transactions can never both hold it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two transactions ever hold the cross-match station at the same time.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p2t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, Total, MaxLease, MaxClock, LeaseDur
ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ MaxLease \in Nat /\ MaxClock \in Nat /\ LeaseDur \in Nat

Min(a, b) == IF a < b THEN a ELSE b

RECURSIVE SumFun(_, _)
SumFun(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumFun(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES pool, held, pendingReturn, leaseExp, clock
vars == <<pool, held, pendingReturn, leaseExp, clock>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ pool \in 0..Total
  /\ held \in [Machines -> 0..Total]
  /\ pendingReturn \in [Machines -> 0..Total]
  /\ leaseExp \in [Machines -> 0..MaxClock]
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock

Init ==
  /\ pool = Total
  /\ held = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ pendingReturn = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ leaseExp = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ clock = 0

GrantLease(m, k) ==
  /\ held[m] = 0
  /\ pendingReturn[m] = 0
  /\ k >= 1 /\ k <= MaxLease /\ k <= pool
  /\ pool' = pool - k
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = k]
  /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![m] = Min(clock + LeaseDur, MaxClock)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingReturn, clock>>

RenewLease(m) ==
  /\ held[m] > 0
  /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![m] = Min(clock + LeaseDur, MaxClock)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, pendingReturn, clock>>

ExpireLease(m) ==
  /\ held[m] > 0
  /\ clock >= leaseExp[m]
  /\ pendingReturn' = [pendingReturn EXCEPT ![m] = held[m]]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, leaseExp, clock>>

DeliverReturn(m) ==
  /\ pendingReturn[m] > 0
  /\ pool' = pool + pendingReturn[m]
  /\ pendingReturn' = [pendingReturn EXCEPT ![m] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, leaseExp, clock>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, pendingReturn, leaseExp>>

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Machines : RenewLease(m) \/ ExpireLease(m) \/ DeliverReturn(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines, k \in 1..MaxLease : GrantLease(m, k)
  \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Stock is conserved across depot, machine holdings, and the return channel.
StockConserved ==
  pool + SumFun(held, Machines) + SumFun(pendingReturn, Machines) = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {a, b}
  Total = 3
  MaxLease = 2
  MaxClock = 2
  LeaseDur = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT StockConserved
nl:
A network of vending machines shares one central stock depot. A dispatcher hands out lease-based ownership of stock: a machine with no active lease may take a batch of units from the depot pool under a lease stamped with an expiry time drawn from the current clock. While the lease is live the machine holds that stock and may renew the lease to push its expiry later. A global clock ticks forward. When a lease's expiry is reached the held stock is pulled off the machine into a pending-return channel rather than vanishing. Return messages travel back to the depot and can be delivered in any order, not necessarily the order the leases expired; delivering a machine's pending return adds its units back to the depot pool. No unit of stock is ever created or destroyed as it moves between the depot pool, the machines, and the return channel. The total stock across the depot, all machine holdings, and all pending returns must stay constant for the life of the network.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The depot pool plus all leased holdings plus all pending returns always equal the fixed total stock.

EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxEpoch, MaxCap
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

VARIABLES epoch, cap, occ, crashed
vars == <<epoch, cap, occ, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
  /\ occ \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Controllers

Live == { c \in Controllers : c \notin crashed }

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ cap = 1
  /\ occ = 0
  /\ crashed = {}

AdmitTrain ==
  /\ Live # {}
  /\ occ < cap
  /\ occ' = occ + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, crashed>>

DepartTrain ==
  /\ occ > 0
  /\ occ' = occ - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, crashed>>

\* A reconfiguration installs a new capacity no smaller than current occupancy.
Reconfigure(newcap) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ Live # {}
  /\ newcap >= occ
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ cap' = newcap
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, crashed>>

\* At most one controller may crash, and it does so silently.
CrashSilently(c) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap, occ>>

Next ==
  \/ AdmitTrain
  \/ DepartTrain
  \/ \E nc \in 1..MaxCap : Reconfigure(nc)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : CrashSilently(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Occupancy always stays within the current epoch's configured capacity.
OccupancyWithinCapacity == occ <= cap
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Controllers = {c1, c2}
  MaxEpoch = 3
  MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OccupancyWithinCapacity
nl:
A subway signalling section admits trains under a set of block controllers, and its safe capacity is set by an epoch-numbered configuration. The line supervisor can reconfigure the section, which advances the epoch and installs a new capacity; a reconfiguration is only ever installed with a capacity at least as large as the trains currently occupying the section, so a reconfigure never strands trains over the limit. Trains are admitted one at a time and depart one at a time. Admitting a train requires at least one live controller and a free capacity slot under the current epoch's limit. One controller can crash silently, dropping out without any announcement, but because more than one controller watches the section a silent crash still leaves a live controller able to gate admissions. Through reconfigurations, a silent crash, and arbitrary admit/depart interleavings, the section must never hold more trains than the current epoch's capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The section occupancy never exceeds the current epoch's configured capacity.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m5p4t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Replicas, Lobbies, Capacity, Quorum
ASSUME Capacity \in Nat /\ Quorum \in Nat

None == "none"
Ballots == {"none", "yes", "no"}

VARIABLES size, proposal, proposer, ballots
vars == <<size, proposal, proposer, ballots>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ size \in [Lobbies -> 0..Capacity]
  /\ proposal \in (Lobbies \cup {None})
  /\ proposer \in (Replicas \cup {None})
  /\ ballots \in [Replicas -> Ballots]

YesCount == Cardinality({ r \in Replicas : ballots[r] = "yes" })

Init ==
  /\ size = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
  /\ proposal = None
  /\ proposer = None
  /\ ballots = [r \in Replicas |-> "none"]

Propose(r, l) ==
  /\ proposal = None
  /\ size[l] < Capacity
  /\ proposal' = l
  /\ proposer' = r
  /\ ballots' = [rr \in Replicas |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED size

CastVote(r, v) ==
  /\ proposal # None
  /\ ballots[r] = "none"
  /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![r] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<size, proposal, proposer>>

CommitAdmit ==
  /\ proposal # None
  /\ YesCount >= Quorum
  /\ size[proposal] < Capacity
  /\ size' = [size EXCEPT ![proposal] = @ + 1]
  /\ proposal' = None
  /\ proposer' = None
  /\ ballots' = [r \in Replicas |-> "none"]

AbandonProposal ==
  /\ proposal # None
  /\ proposal' = None
  /\ proposer' = None
  /\ ballots' = [r \in Replicas |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED size

Leave(l) ==
  /\ size[l] > 0
  /\ size' = [size EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, proposer, ballots>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Replicas, l \in Lobbies : Propose(r, l)
  \/ \E r \in Replicas, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(r, v)
  \/ CommitAdmit
  \/ AbandonProposal
  \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Leave(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lobby is ever filled beyond its capacity.
LobbyWithinCapacity == \A l \in Lobbies : size[l] <= Capacity
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Replicas = {r1, r2, r3}
  Lobbies = {g1, g2}
  Capacity = 2
  Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LobbyWithinCapacity
nl:
A multiplayer game service runs a matchmaker replicated across several nodes that fills game lobbies, each with a fixed player capacity. Admitting a player into a lobby is not unilateral: a replica proposes an admit for a target lobby, and the admit only takes effect once a quorum of replicas has voted yes on it. Vote messages travel over the network and can arrive in any order, so replicas cast their ballots for the current proposal in arbitrary order. A proposal commits only when the yes votes reach quorum and the target lobby still has room, at which point one player seat is filled and the ballot slate resets for the next proposal. A proposal can also be abandoned, clearing it without changing any lobby. Players already seated can leave, freeing a seat. Because every admit must clear quorum and re-check room at commit time, no lobby can ever be pushed past its capacity, regardless of how votes are reordered or proposals abandoned.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No lobby ever holds more players than its fixed capacity.

Bump(t) == IF t < MaxTerm THEN t + 1 ELSE t

  /\ role \in [Cars -> {"follower", "leader"}]
  /\ termOf \in [Cars -> 0..MaxTerm]
  /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap
  /\ outstanding \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ acting \in (Cars \cup {None})

  /\ role = [c \in Cars |-> "follower"]
  /\ termOf = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ outstanding = 0
  /\ acting = None

BecomeDispatcher(c) ==

  /\ acting = None
  /\ term' = Bump(term)
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![c] = "leader"]
  /\ termOf' = [termOf EXCEPT ![c] = Bump(term)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, outstanding, acting>>

StepDown(c) ==
  /\ role[c] = "leader"
  /\ acting # c
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![c] = "follower"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, termOf, capacity, outstanding, acting>>

BeginDispatch(c) ==

  /\ role[c] = "leader"
  /\ termOf[c] = term
  /\ acting' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, termOf, capacity, outstanding>>

CommitDispatch(c) ==
  /\ acting = c
  /\ outstanding < capacity
  /\ outstanding' = outstanding + 1
  /\ acting' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, termOf, capacity>>

CompleteCall ==

  /\ outstanding' = outstanding - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, termOf, capacity, acting>>

  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, role, termOf, outstanding, acting>>

CONSTANTS
  Cars = {a, b}
  MaxTerm = 3
  MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyCurrentDispatcherActs
nl:
An elevator bank is coordinated by a dispatcher role that any car can take over. Leadership uses failover with terms: a car becomes dispatcher by adopting a new term, and a car can step down. Only the car acting as dispatcher for the current term may drive a dispatch. A dispatch happens in two steps: the current-term dispatcher first begins a dispatch, entering an acting state, then commits it, which assigns a car to an outstanding call and clears the acting state. Leadership only changes while no dispatch is in progress, so a car cannot become dispatcher or step down mid-dispatch. Completing a served call reduces the outstanding count. The fleet's dispatch capacity changes at runtime as cars go in and out of service, so a supervisor can reconfigure the capacity up or down at any time, and a commit is only allowed while outstanding calls are below the current capacity. The central guarantee is that no stale or unauthorized car ever drives a dispatch: whenever a car is in the acting state it must currently be the dispatcher and its remembered term must equal the current term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a car is in the acting-dispatch state it is the current dispatcher whose remembered term equals the current term.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m2p3t5 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, Bays, Stages, MaxOverrides
ASSUME MaxOverrides \in Nat

None == "none"
Ballots == {"none", "yes", "no"}

VARIABLES bayOwner, assignedBay, proposal, votes, overrides
vars == <<bayOwner, assignedBay, proposal, votes, overrides>>

Proposals == [active : BOOLEAN, car : Cars, bay : Bays]

TypeOK ==
  /\ bayOwner \in [Bays -> (Cars \cup {None})]
  /\ assignedBay \in [Cars -> (Bays \cup {None})]
  /\ proposal \in Proposals
  /\ votes \in [Stages -> Ballots]
  /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

SomeCar == CHOOSE c \in Cars : TRUE
SomeBay == CHOOSE b \in Bays : TRUE

Init ==
  /\ bayOwner = [b \in Bays |-> None]
  /\ assignedBay = [c \in Cars |-> None]
  /\ proposal = [active |-> FALSE, car |-> SomeCar, bay |-> SomeBay]
  /\ votes = [s \in Stages |-> "none"]
  /\ overrides = 0

Propose(car, bay) ==
  /\ ~proposal.active
  /\ assignedBay[car] = None
  /\ bayOwner[bay] = None
  /\ proposal' = [active |-> TRUE, car |-> car, bay |-> bay]
  /\ votes' = [s \in Stages |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bayOwner, assignedBay, overrides>>

Vote(s, v) ==
  /\ proposal.active
  /\ votes[s] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bayOwner, assignedBay, proposal, overrides>>

Commit ==
  /\ proposal.active
  /\ \A s \in Stages : votes[s] = "yes"
  /\ bayOwner[proposal.bay] = None
  /\ assignedBay[proposal.car] = None
  /\ bayOwner' = [bayOwner EXCEPT ![proposal.bay] = proposal.car]
  /\ assignedBay' = [assignedBay EXCEPT ![proposal.car] = proposal.bay]
  /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT !.active = FALSE]
  /\ votes' = [s \in Stages |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED overrides

Abandon ==
  /\ proposal.active
  /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT !.active = FALSE]
  /\ votes' = [s \in Stages |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bayOwner, assignedBay, overrides>>

Release(car) ==
  /\ assignedBay[car] # None
  /\ bayOwner' = [bayOwner EXCEPT ![assignedBay[car]] = None]
  /\ assignedBay' = [assignedBay EXCEPT ![car] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, overrides>>

AdminOverride(bay) ==
  /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
  /\ bayOwner[bay] # None
  /\ assignedBay' = [assignedBay EXCEPT ![bayOwner[bay]] = None]
  /\ bayOwner' = [bayOwner EXCEPT ![bay] = None]
  /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E car \in Cars, bay \in Bays : Propose(car, bay)
  \/ \E s \in Stages, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(s, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abandon
  \/ \E car \in Cars : Release(car)
  \/ \E bay \in Bays : AdminOverride(bay)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bay-occupant and car-assignment records are exact inverses (no bay double-booked).
AllocationConsistent ==
  /\ \A b \in Bays : (bayOwner[b] # None) => (assignedBay[bayOwner[b]] = b)
  /\ \A c \in Cars : (assignedBay[c] # None) => (bayOwner[assignedBay[c]] = c)

nl:
A car-wash conveyor line has numbered wash bays, and cars are allocated to bays only after a two-phase commit across the stage controllers (pre-soak, wash, and wax) all agree.   /\ status[d] = "armed"
  /\ firedBy = None
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![d] = "fired"]
  /\ firedBy' = d
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, overrides>>

\* Privileged override: drop all locks and disarm, but never undo a detonation.
AdminOverride ==
  /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
  /\ (coarse # None \/ \E d \in Drones : status[d] = "armed")
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ fine' = [s \in Sectors |-> None]
  /\ status' = [d \in Drones |-> IF status[d] = "armed" THEN "idle" ELSE status[d]]
  /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED firedBy

ReleaseFine(d, s) ==
  /\ fine[s] = d
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, status, firedBy, overrides>>

ReleaseCoarse(d) ==
  /\ coarse = d
  /\ \A s \in Sectors : fine[s] # d
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, status, firedBy, overrides>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : AcquireCoarse(d) \/ Arm(d) \/ ReleaseCoarse(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : AcquireFine(d, s) \/ Fire(d, s) \/ ReleaseFine(d, s)
  \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible detonation is single-shot: any fired drone is the latched detonator.
SingleFirebreak == \A d \in Drones : (status[d] = "fired") => (d = firedBy)
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Drones = {a, b}
  Sectors = {x1, x2}
  MaxOverrides = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SingleFirebreak
nl:
A wildfire drone swarm can trigger a single irreversible firebreak detonation, which must happen at most once across the whole mission. To act, a drone acquires authorization hierarchically: first the coarse region lock, then the fine lock on the sector it will treat. Holding the coarse lock, a drone arms itself. A drone that holds the coarse lock, holds the fine lock for its sector, and is armed may fire the firebreak charge, but only if no drone has fired before; firing latches the firing drone as the one and only detonator. A privileged mission commander may issue an override at any time, which releases all locks and disarms every armed drone so authorization must be re-established, for example on a sudden replan; the override never undoes a detonation that already happened. Drones release fine locks per sector and drop the coarse lock only when holding no fine locks. Across every interleaving of locking, arming, and commander overrides, the irreversible firebreak detonation occurs at most once, and any drone recorded as having fired is exactly the latched detonator.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any drone in the fired state is the single latched detonator, so the firebreak detonation happens at most once.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m9p5t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Modes, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

None == "none"
Bump(e) == IF e < MaxEpoch THEN e + 1 ELSE e

VARIABLES epoch, inbox, mode, finalizer, issued
vars == <<epoch, inbox, mode, finalizer, issued>>

SomeMode == CHOOSE m \in Modes : TRUE

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ inbox \in SUBSET Modes
  /\ mode \in Modes
  /\ finalizer \in (Controllers \cup {None})
  /\ issued \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ inbox = {}
  /\ mode = SomeMode
  /\ finalizer = None
  /\ issued = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]

SubmitCommand(m) ==
  /\ m \notin inbox
  /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mode, finalizer, issued>>

\* Reordered: any queued command may be applied next; the epoch advances.
ApplyReconfig(m) ==
  /\ m \in inbox
  /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
  /\ mode' = m
  /\ epoch' = Bump(epoch)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<finalizer, issued>>

\* Irreversible one-time certification, latched to a single certifier.
Certify(c) ==
  /\ finalizer = None
  /\ finalizer' = c
  /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inbox, mode>>

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Modes : SubmitCommand(m) \/ ApplyReconfig(m)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Certify(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Certification is single-shot: any controller with its issued flag set is the
\* one latched certifier.
SingleCertifier == \A c \in Controllers : issued[c] => (c = finalizer)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Controllers = {c1, c2}
  Modes = {normal, fire, maint}
  MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SingleCertifier
nl:
An elevator bank controller retunes its operating mode through epoch-numbered reconfiguration. Reconfiguration commands, each naming a target mode, are filed into an inbox and can be applied in any order because they arrive over a shared bus that reorders them. Applying a command switches the bank to that mode and advances the epoch number. Separately, the bank issues a one-time irreversible safety certificate for the installation: this may be issued by at most one controller for the whole life of the bank. When a controller issues the certificate it is latched as the sole certifier and its own issued flag is set. Reconfiguration keeps happening freely before and after certification; the certificate does not freeze the mode, it only records that certification has occurred. Any controller whose issued flag is set must be exactly the latched certifier, so no matter how reconfiguration commands are reordered or how the epoch advances, the irreversible certificate is issued at most once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller whose issued flag is set is exactly the latched sole certifier, so certification happens at most once.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m0p3t5 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Slots, MaxVersion, MaxOverrides
ASSUME MaxVersion \in Nat /\ MaxOverrides \in Nat

Bump(v) == IF v < MaxVersion THEN v + 1 ELSE v

VARIABLES allocated, version, pending, overrides
vars == <<allocated, version, pending, overrides>>

Attempts == [drone : Drones, slot : Slots, seen : 0..MaxVersion]
SlotAllocated(s) == \E p \in allocated : p[1] = s
HasAttempt(d, s) == \E a \in pending : a.drone = d /\ a.slot = s
DropSlot(s) == { p \in allocated : p[1] # s }

TypeOK ==
  /\ allocated \in SUBSET (Slots \X Drones)
  /\ version \in [Slots -> 0..MaxVersion]
  /\ pending \in SUBSET Attempts
  /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
  /\ allocated = {}
  /\ version = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ overrides = 0

\* Optimistic read: snapshot the slot version into a fresh attempt.
Prepare(d, s) ==
  /\ ~HasAttempt(d, s)
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {[drone |-> d, slot |-> s, seen |-> version[s]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, version, overrides>>

CommitOk(a) ==
  /\ a \in pending
  /\ version[a.slot] = a.seen
  /\ ~SlotAllocated(a.slot)
  /\ allocated' = allocated \cup {<<a.slot, a.drone>>}
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![a.slot] = Bump(@)]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED overrides

CommitStale(a) ==
  /\ a \in pending
  /\ version[a.slot] # a.seen
  /\ pending' = pending \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, version, overrides>>

Release(s) ==
  /\ SlotAllocated(s)
  /\ allocated' = DropSlot(s)
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(@)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, overrides>>

AdminOverride(s) ==
  /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
  /\ SlotAllocated(s)
  /\ allocated' = DropSlot(s)
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(@)]
  /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Slots : Prepare(d, s)
  \/ \E a \in pending : CommitOk(a) \/ CommitStale(a)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s) \/ AdminOverride(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Allocation records are functional on slots: never two drones for one slot.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A p, q \in allocated : (p[1] = q[1]) => (p[2] = q[2])
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Drones = {d1, d2}
  Slots = {s1, s2}
  MaxVersion = 2
  MaxOverrides = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A wildfire drone swarm allocates survey slots to drones using optimistic locking with retry. Each slot carries a version stamp. A drone prepares a claim by reading the slot's current version into a pending attempt, then later tries to commit it. A commit succeeds only if the slot is still unallocated and its version stamp still matches the value the attempt read; on success the slot is allocated to that drone and its version is bumped. If the version no longer matches because someone else moved it, the attempt is stale and is discarded so the drone must retry with a fresh read. A drone can release a slot it holds, bumping the version and freeing it. A privileged flight commander may issue an admin override on a slot, forcibly clearing its allocation and bumping its version so it can be reclaimed. Allocations are kept as slot-to-drone records, and the core guarantee is that these records stay functional on the slot: a slot is never recorded as allocated to two different drones at once, no matter how attempts are retried, released, or overridden.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No slot is ever recorded as allocated to two different drones.
